title: Kafka Producer

fields.name: aws_msk_iam
fields.description: Enable AWS MSK IAM authentication.

fields.name: aws_msk_iam_cluster_arn
fields.description: Full ARN of the MSK cluster used for region extraction.

fields.name: brokers
fields.description: Single or multiple list of Kafka brokers.

fields.name: client_id
fields.description: Client ID to use when connecting to Kafka.

fields.name: dynamic_topic
fields.description: Adds unknown topics (found in topic_key) to topics.

fields.name: format
fields.description: Specify data format.

fields.name: gelf_full_message_key
fields.description: Key to use as the long message for GELF format output.

fields.name: gelf_host_key
fields.description: Key to use as the host for GELF format output.

fields.name: gelf_level_key
fields.description: Key to use as the log level for GELF format output.

fields.name: gelf_short_message_key
fields.description: Key to use as the short message for GELF format output.

fields.name: gelf_timestamp_key
fields.description: Key to use as the timestamp for GELF format output.

fields.name: group_id
fields.description: Consumer group ID.

fields.name: message_key
fields.description: Optional key to store the message.

fields.name: message_key_field
fields.description: If set, the value of message_key_field in the record will indicate the message key.

fields.name: queue_full_retries
fields.description: Number of local retries to enqueue data when the rdkafka queue is full.

fields.name: raw_log_key
fields.description: When using the raw format, the value of raw_log_key in the record is sent to Kafka as the payload.

fields.name: rdkafka.{property}
fields.description: {property} can be any [librdkafka property](https://github.com/confluentinc/librdkafka/blob/master/CONFIGURATION.md).

fields.name: schema_id
fields.description: Avro schema ID.

fields.name: schema_str
fields.description: Avro schema string.

fields.name: timestamp_format
fields.description: Specify the timestamp format.

fields.name: timestamp_key
fields.description: Key to store the record timestamp.

fields.name: topic_key
fields.description: If multiple topics exist, the value of topic_key in the record indicates the topic to use.

fields.name: topics
fields.description: Single topic or comma-separated list of topics that Fluent Bit will use to send messages to Kafka.

fields.name: workers
fields.description: The number of [workers](/manual/administration/multithreading.md#outputs) to perform flush operations for this output.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.

description: The Kafka Producer output plugin lets you ingest your records into an Apache Kafka service.
